value.name: Micky wakes and takes painkillers
value.description: Micky wakes up on the couch, gets a beer, and swallows pain pills while still wearing his clothes and head bandages.
evidence: Micky lies sleeping in his clothes on the couch, bandages on his head. He sits up, TV playing.
He gets up and walks into the small kitchen, grabs a beer out of the refrigerator, swallows some PAIN pills.

value.name: Micky hesitates to call Charlene
value.description: Micky picks up Charlene's napkin with her number, starts dialing, then hangs up without calling her.
evidence: And picks up the cocktail NAPKIN WITH CHARLENE'S NUMBER AND HEART ON IT.
Picks up the phone, starts to dial, stops, looks at the number. Hangs up the phone.

value.name: Micky falls back asleep
value.description: After abandoning the call, Micky returns to the couch and falls asleep again.
evidence: Goes back into the living room and lies down on the couch and falls asleep again.

value.name: Charlene arrives and knocks on Micky's door
value.description: The next morning, Charlene comes to Micky's apartment and bangs on the door until he wakes up.
evidence: MICKY'S STILL SLEEPING IN HIS CLOTHES ON THE COUCH, TV STILL ON, MORNING LIGHT BLEEDING THROUGH THE SHADES. HE IS WOKEN BY BANGING ON HIS DOOR.
He gets up off the couch and peeks through the shade.. .AND SEES CHARLENE STANDING ON HIS DOORSTEP.

value.name: Micky hides from Charlene
value.description: Seeing Charlene at the door, Micky panics and crouches behind a chair instead of answering her.
evidence: Scared, he ducks back down, crouches behind a chair.

value.name: Charlene calls out Micky's avoidance
value.description: Charlene says she saw Micky's shadow and demands that he explain why he did not call her yesterday.
evidence: CHARLENE (OS) I saw your shadow. And I heard you talk two seconds ago!
CHARLENE (OS) Why don't you open the door and tell me to my face why you didn't call me yestahday?

value.name: Micky opens the door to Charlene
value.description: Micky finally goes to the door and opens it, revealing his bandaged face to Charlene.
evidence: Micky thinks, goes to the door, opens it.
Charlene is slightly taken aback by his bandaged face.
